triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: It was supposed afterwards that he had come to stay with them as Marya Kondratyevna’s betrothed

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Then you ought, as your father’s son, to have had me taken to the lock-up and thrashed at once for my words then

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: So you thought then, you scoundrel, that together with Dmitri I meant to kill my father?

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: for I thought if you wanted the same as your brother, then the business was as good as settled

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: so his share of the inheritance would come to you and your brother Alexey Fyodorovitch in equal parts

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Ivan jumped up and struck him with all his might on the shoulder, so that he fell back against the wall.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: in the same complacent and sententious tone in which he had taunted Grigory and argued with him about religion at Fyodor Pavlovitch’s table

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: the dilapidated little wooden house, divided in two by a passage on one side of which lived Marya Kondratyevna and her mother, and on the other, Smerdyakov.

triples.subject: Marya Kondratyevna
triples.quote: the dilapidated little wooden house, divided in two by a passage on one side of which lived Marya Kondratyevna and her mother, and on the other, Smerdyakov.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: if I don’t beat you to death, it’s simply because I suspect you of that crime and I’ll drag you to justice.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: To-morrow I will get the money and repay your three thousand and farewell, woman of great wrath, but farewell, too, my love!

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Better Siberia than your love, for I love another woman and you got to know her too well to-day, so how can you forgive?

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: They were like two enemies in love with one another.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: They were like two enemies in love with one another.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: in the evening he was at the “Metropolis,” where he got thoroughly drunk.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: went to her writing-table, opened a box standing on it, took out a sheet of paper and laid it before Ivan.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: This was the document of which Ivan spoke to Alyosha later on as a “conclusive proof” that Dmitri had killed his father.
